summary: Comprehensive testing of Crystal Guide deep content feature. Backend /api/crystals/deep returns all 27 crystals with why_this_heals, extended_teachings, practice_guide. Frontend dialog shows all rich sections. GuidedPracticeOverlay launches correctly with timer matching crystal meditation duration.

issues: MODERATE: Several crystal cards have irrelevant Unsplash images - Clear Quartz shows apples, Amethyst shows laptop keyboard. These are completely unrelated to crystals and reduce UX quality.
MINOR: Subtitle '27 crystals, each carrying deep wisdom...' does not update when element filter is applied (still shows '27 crystals' when only 2 Earth crystals are displayed after filtering).

backend_tests.details: All 27 crystals have: why_this_heals, extended_teachings, practice_guide, healing_properties (physical/emotional/spiritual), cleansing_methods, rituals, combinations, affirmation, stone vitals. No MongoDB _id leakage. Individual crystal endpoint /api/crystals/deep/{id} works.

action_items: MODERATE: Fix irrelevant crystal images - Clear Quartz displays apple fruit image, Amethyst displays laptop keyboard. Update image_url fields in crystals_deep.py to use relevant crystal photos.
MINOR: Optionally update subtitle text in CrystalGuide.jsx to reflect filtered count (e.g. 'Showing 2 Earth crystals' when filtered) - currently static '27 crystals'.
critical_code_review_comments: Crystal images from Unsplash appear to be generic/random - Clear Quartz shows apples, Amethyst shows a laptop. The image_url values in crystals_deep.py point to incorrect Unsplash photos that don't match the crystals.
CrystalGuide.jsx line 186: Hardcoded '27 crystals' subtitle text should dynamically show filteredCrystals.length for better UX.
GuidedPracticeOverlay correctly uses duration_minutes from practice object - timer accurately matches crystal meditation duration (15:00 for Clear Quartz, 20:00 for Amethyst).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all required features work; irrelevant images is design issue only)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Crystal Guide fully tested. /api/crystals/deep returns 27 crystals each with why_this_heals, extended_teachings, practice_guide (deep teachings applied via startup seeding from crystals_deep_teachings.py).
